quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (separate, K-IFRS; no subsidiaries): Q2 2026 revenue KRW 94,873,213,359 vs KRW 72,674,140,670 in Q2 2025; Q2 operating profit KRW 26,849,503,480 vs KRW 19,501,585,703; Q2 net income KRW 23,650,653,316. H1 2026 revenue KRW 190,264,732,356 vs KRW 151,036,177,016; H1 operating profit KRW 55,403,971,977 vs KRW 42,975,089,844; H1 net income KRW 48,763,300,047. H1 mix (KRW million): Solid SiC semiconductor process parts (SiC rings, SiC wafers) 170,896 (89.8%) vs 124,151 (82.2%) a year earlier; high-purity graphite for semiconductor 13,457 (7.1%) vs 18,845 (12.5%); graphite for solar 383 (0.2%); susceptors for LED and semiconductor 5,155 (2.7%) vs 7,355 (4.9%); heaters and other goods 373 (0.2%). Exports KRW 117,271M of which Solid SiC KRW 112,542M. Revenue by customer location (KRW thousand): Korea 72,993,439, United States 80,954,171, China 35,680,220, other 636,902. FY2025 reference: revenue KRW 301,334,303K, operating profit KRW 83,887,319K.

Order backlog at 06-30-2026 of 1,993.7 in units of KRW 100 million: Solid SiC 1,763.0, graphite 192.9, susceptors 37.7 (orders are received continuously per customer, so delivered amounts are not shown). Customers above the disclosure threshold (names undisclosed) contributed H1 revenue of KRW 37,879,162K (customer 1), KRW 41,678,379K (customer 2), KRW 29,889,096K (customer 3) and KRW 28,007,229K (customer 4), vs KRW 19,592,312K, KRW 34,768,188K, KRW 19,561,027K and KRW 31,849,551K in H1 2025. The report describes main customers as makers of semiconductor and solar ingots, LED chips and semiconductor equipment, and says its localized SiC cathodes and SiC rings hold a high market share. Trade receivables rose to KRW 66,125,363K from KRW 45,764,045K at year-end.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and capex: Ansung plant utilisation for ceramic products (rings etc.) was 96.2% in H1 2026 (970 of 1,008 available hours); H1 production at cost was 1,210 (KRW 100 million) vs 1,916 for FY2025. The company completed machinery and facility expansion worth 243 (KRW 100 million) between 2022-04 and 2024-07, and is investing about 257 (KRW 100 million) in land for a new plant, with completion now scheduled for 2026-10-31 after several extensions (previously 2026-06-30). H1 PP&E additions KRW 3,338,388K with KRW 11,602,135K of construction in progress moved into machinery; the board approved an R&D equipment investment and a business-cooperation and non-disclosure agreement (counterparty not named) on 2026-03-18. The company has no borrowings.
quarterly_data.figure: Ansung ceramic-products utilisation 96.2%; new-plant land investment about 257 (KRW 100 million) due 10-31-2026

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier: Tokai Carbon Korea buys its main raw material, high-purity graphite, from its 52.63% parent Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. (Japan), with unit prices negotiated each year in yen; H1 raw-material purchases were graphite KRW 14,206M (95.0%) and graphite foil etc. KRW 754M (5.0%). Related-party purchases from Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. were KRW 12,569,838K in H1 2026 (H1 2025: KRW 15,699,911K) and technology royalties under a 2019 technology licence (10 years from 2019-01-01, auto-renewing) KRW 5,100,690K (KRW 3,687,442K). A sales-support fee agreement with KC Co. (2% of Solid SiC ring sales; KRW 2,988,772K in H1) was amended on 2026-03-31 to end on 2026-12-31 without renewal. Sales to group affiliate Tokai Carbon (Dalian) were KRW 5,306,338K.
quarterly_data.figure: Graphite purchases KRW 14,206M (95.0%); purchases from Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. KRW 12,569,838K; royalties KRW 5,100,690K

quarterly_data.signal: Products and R&D per the half-year report: Tokai Carbon Korea makes CVD-SiC rings for semiconductor etch processes (developed to replace silicon rings, with higher plasma resistance and no impurities), solid SiC dummy and monitoring wafers including a 12-inch SiC wafer, CVD-SiC-coated graphite susceptors for semiconductor deposition (ALD) tools, CVD-SiC-coated C/C composite heaters, LED MOCVD susceptors and high-purity graphite for silicon-ingot growers. The report says advancing process miniaturisation is making Solid-SiC manufacturing technology a competitive factor. R&D spend KRW 2,319,056K (1.22% of revenue), 21 researchers.
quarterly_data.figure: CVD-SiC etch rings, 12-inch SiC wafers, SiC-coated susceptors; R&D KRW 2,319,056K (1.22%)
